items.title: Yelp Migrates Cassandra to EKS by Moving EBS Volumes
items.summaryShort: Yelp Migrates Cassandra to EKS by Moving EBS Volumes. Yelp has moved its Cassandra fleet from legacy self-managed Kubernetes clusters to Amazon EKS by re-pointing existing EBS volumes at new pods, rather than streaming data between nodes.
